surface_value: Marijuana contains chemicals like delta-9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) and cannabidiol (CBD) that can produce effects on the body such as euphoria, reduce anxiety, inflammation, and paranoia. THC is used to treat nausea and pain, while CBD is used to treat seizures.
